$comment: The Exchange (design §9): the silent barter caravan. Rates derive from the single trade-value table (resources.json values + recipe derivation), never authored per pair — exchangeRate(a->b) = tradeValue(a)/tradeValue(b)*(1-spread). Trades are exact (goods are fractional): rounding UP would mint value on a round trip, so the spread is the only cut. There is no Coin — goods buy goods. The caravan names the deal: one from-good for one to-good, drawn deterministically from the wall-clock window and changing every offerMinutes; every quality tier of the from-good trades in (Decent/Choice at their §5 value multipliers), always paid out in plain goods. spread and offerMinutes are first guesses.
